verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation of chunked or resumable upload sessions in the Dropbox API. The closest item is a developer-blog title about uploading 'in a performant manner', which says nothing about chunking or surviving a dropped connection. The 'Transfer files up to 50/100 GB' lines are plan limits for an end-user product, not an API upload-session capability.

support.subject: As a developer, big files upload reliably — documented chunked/resumable upload sessions that survive a dropped connection
